column1: # Digest-pinned grandfather ledger for the directory-size and naming gate
# list of the directories that were already over the 40-non-test-.go-file
# cap when the gate landed, so the gate lands green on today's tree and new
# This file is the single source of truth. tools/golangci-lint-dirgate/grandfather.go
# is GENERATED from it by scripts/generate-dirgate-grandfather-go.sh (see that
# reads this file directly. Regenerate the .go file after editing this TSV.
#   dir        - package directory path relative to the go/ module root.
#   file_count - the exact count of qualifying (non-test, non-generated,
#                non-vendor, non-testdata) .go files in `dir` at the commit
#                this row was pinned. A directory PASSES at this count or
#                below (files may be removed freely); it FAILS the moment
#                its live count exceeds file_count (a new file was added).
#   digest     - sha256 hex of the sorted qualifying basenames in `dir`,
#                newline-joined with a trailing newline, at the same commit.
#                Used only when the live count still EQUALS file_count: it
#                catches a same-count file swap (one file removed, a
#                different one added) that pure counting would miss.
# The list only shrinks. Removing a row (once its directory's real,
# unpinned count is <= 40 and every qualifying file has moved) is the
# expected way to retire an entry -- never bump file_count upward by hand.
# digest for a directory so you can update or drop a row honestly.
# Seeded at #6054 landing from the pre-existing tree (see #6053).
